Haverford Financial Services Maintains Holding in Synchrony Finan (SYF); Target (TGT) Shareholder Cadence Bank Na Has Increased Holding
June 29, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Cadence Bank Na increased its stake in Target Corp (TGT) by 164.82% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cadence Bank Na bought 24,726 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.40% with the market. The institutional investor held 39,728 shares of the department and specialty retail stores company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.76 million, up from 15,002 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cadence Bank Na who had been investing in Target Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $40.31B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.65% or $1.27 during the last trading session, reaching $75.6. About 4.67 million shares traded. Target Corporation (NYSE:TGT) has risen 31.38% since June 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 18.81% the S&P500. Baer joins CamberView Partners as Senior Advisor; 23/04/2018 – TARGET BOOSTING NUMBER OF ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING SITES; 21/05/2018 – Target Corp expected to post earnings of $1.39 a share – Earnings Preview; 15/03/2018 – CFO Smith Disposes 271 Of Target Corp; 14/03/2018 – Amazon-owned Whole Foods, Kroger and Target, meanwhile, are investing in some of the same initiatives; 23/05/2018 – TARGET CORP – QTRLY COMPARABLE SALES GROWTH OF 3.0 PERCENT; 06/03/2018 – TARGET REPORTS PLANS TO ACCELERATE MULTIYEAR STRATEGY; 22/03/2018 – SHIPT & TARGET LAUNCH SAME-DAY DELIVERY IN PHILADELPHIA; 17/04/2018 – TARGET: DRIVE UP AVAILABLE AT ~270 STORES IN FL, TX, SOUTHEAST
Haverford Financial Services Inc increased its stake in Synchrony Finan (SYF) by 75.34% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Haverford Financial Services Inc bought 9,410 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.76% with the market. The institutional investor held 21,900 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $734,000, up from 12,490 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Haverford Financial Services Inc who had been investing in Synchrony Finan for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $24.92 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.03% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $33.01. About 4.45M shares traded. Synchrony Financial (NYSE:SYF) has risen 30.77% since June 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 18.20% the S&P500. Among 29 analysts covering Target Corporation ( NYSE:TGT ), 11 have Buy rating, 3 Sell and 15 Hold. Therefore 38% are positive. The stock of Target Corporation (NYSE:TGT) has “Outperform” rating given on Thursday, February 25 by Cowen & Co. The rating was maintained by Robert W. Baird with “Buy” on Monday, June 4. On Thursday, December 14 the stock rating was maintained by Bernstein with “Buy”. Wolfe Research downgraded the shares of TGT in report on Friday, April 29 to “Peer Perform” rating. On Tuesday, September 8 the stock rating was upgraded by Vetr to “Strong-Buy”. Wolfe Research downgraded the shares of TGT in report on Wednesday, March 1 to “Underperform” rating. On Tuesday, January 9 the stock rating was maintained by Jefferies with “Hold”. Telsey Advisory Group maintained Target Corporation (NYSE:TGT) on Thursday, August 18 with “Outperform” rating. The rating was initiated by Bernstein with “Outperform” on Tuesday, February 7.
Cadence Bank Na, which manages about $251.29 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 5,528 shares to 15,167 shares, valued at $2.54M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Microsoft Corp (NASDAQ:MSFT) by 7,607 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 56,935 shares, and cut its stake in General Electric Co (NYSE:GE).

The firm has “Buy” rating by BMO Capital Markets given on Wednesday, May 31. The stock has “Market Perform” rating by BMO Capital Markets on Wednesday, September 16. As per Monday, September 18, the company rating was maintained by Jefferies. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Friday, July 21 by BMO Capital Markets. The company was maintained on Friday, January 19 by Susquehanna. Deutsche Bank maintained it with “Buy” rating and $36 target in Wednesday, May 4 report. The rating was maintained by Susquehanna on Thursday, December 28 with “Buy”. Wells Fargo maintained the shares of SYF in report on Monday, October 23 with “Market Perform” rating. The stock of Synchrony Financial (NYSE:SYF) has “Buy” rating given on Wednesday, August 23 by BMO Capital Markets.
